title: Nicaules
summary: Raleigh names Nicaules in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Nicaules, the name Iosephus giues the Queene of Saba. She is not a second woman, and not Sheba the sonne of Bichri. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVIII, §. III, sig. 305b
